summary: n8n-nodes-sysdiag exfiltrates process.env to hardcoded bare IP on module load
details: On module load, the package schedules a deferred bootstrap that copies the entire process.env, base64-encodes it, and POSTs it to the hardcoded bare IP 121.127.33.228 on port 8443 at path /api/v1/nodes/compat. The http module is loaded via a String.fromCharCode-obfuscated char-code array ([104, 116, 116, 112] -> 'http') to conceal the require, and a setTimeout defers the network call to disguise it from load-time inspection. n8n auto-requires community nodes, so installation of this package into an n8n instance causes process.env — which routinely contains n8n credentials, database URLs, and API tokens for connected services — to be transmitted to the hardcoded remote endpoint. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to any n8n publisher, and the framing as a 'compatibility' endpoint is a cover story for credential harvesting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
